entries.0b02f4424523b483: This service centers on 'Gaikin', part-time physician placement using a physician placement website, and 'career', full-time physician placement. It also provides part-time job placement, career change placement and introductory temporary staffing for paramedics such as nurses, pharmacists and clinical laboratory technologists. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,061 million.
entries.251615c78d770e23: This single-segment business, launched on the basis of a mutual aid organization for physicians, is built on a human resources network in the medical field. It consists of medical staffing services centered on physician placement and other services, and revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥4,191 million.
entries.4205180d6af22172: It provides, among others, the groupware 'Net Ikyoku®' supporting medical office work, the online medical consultation and health counseling services 'Door.into Kenko Iryo Sodan' and 'Pocket Doctor', marketing and product development support by physicians, publishing, support for medical institution operations, registration and reception center operations (BPO) for local governments and companies, and a medical device platform. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,130 million.
entries.ef5621a4708afeac: A company that grew out of a mutual aid organization of physicians and operates a medical information platform centered on part-time and full-time physician placement through a physician referral site.
